text: Glad it went through. I found the cause of the glitch: the update download inherited the app's 30 s total timeout (hence 'timeout' at a third of the bar) and updated the screen for every 64 KB chunk (the 'not responding' freeze). Fixed: no total timeout, resumes a cut download up to 4 times, progress throttled, install copy off the main thread. Shipping as v0.114.8 now; you're already on 0.114.7, so this one is the first update that uses the fix.
